Pynchon and Dickens

**Dickens:** dignity meets physical accident.

**Looney Tunes:** the body becomes infinitely deformable under mechanical causality.

**Pynchon:** historical/technical systems acquire Looney Tunes physics.

**After Pynchon:** people become spectators of their own systemic deformation.
